text:
alex: quick heads-up — our p4d RI block in eu-west-1 expires in ~38 days. noticed utilization dipped to ~57% last 30d. :thinking_face:

maria: ugh, figures. is that across dev/staging or prod too?

alex: mostly prod traffic shift to eu-west-2 for a/b experiments + a few long-running finetune jobs moved regions. prod utilization still decent in eu-west-2 but eu-west-1 is underused.

tj: can we reassign some scheduled jobs to eu-west-1? which queues are region-locked?

alex: a couple data-transfer sensitive pipelines are pinned to eu-west-2 for lower egress costs. non-critical fine-tunes can move.

sophia: quick data point — billing shows ~2.1k GPU-hours / mo in eu-west-1 for p4d, reservation covers ~3.9k. so there is headroom but not optimal. link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/billing/home#/cost-explorer (filtered)

maria: options: 1) exchange via reservation marketplace, 2) partial sell + buy reserved in eu-west-2, 3) wait and renew but run discounted spot hybrids to soak usage. what’s risk appetite?

alex: prefer phased approach. keep critical coverage, gradually rebalance non-critical workloads. avoid big one-time exchanges unless we confirm long-term region tilt.

kevin: +1 phased. can we run a 4-week experiment: 30% of batch fine-tunes shifted to eu-west-1 and track latency/cost delta? if impact <5% latency and cost drops, scale more.

tj: I can add tagging on jobs to track region moves and run cost/latency dashboard. will push a quick query to lookback.

infra-bot: [cost-alert] SavingsPlan utilization for p4d in eu-west-1: 57% (30d). Projected unused hours if unchanged: 1.8k / mo.

maria: thanks infra-bot. alex, can you own the job migration experiment? set success criteria and rollback plan.

alex: I’ll own it. success = no more than 5% median GPU latency increase for fine-tunes and >=15% bump in reservation utilization in eu-west-1 after 4 weeks. rollback = revert job routes and notify infra.

sophia: add a query snippet for tracking: ```sql
SELECT region, SUM(gpu_hours) as hours, reservation_coverage
FROM gpu_billing
WHERE timestamp >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)
GROUP BY region;
```

maria: also flag: if market exchange price (AWS marketplace) shows >20% premium, avoid selling — prefer cross-region buy + staged shutdowns.

kevin: I'll prepare a small runbook for the migration steps and cost checkpoints. tag me when you start so SRE can watch network egress.

alex: starting migrations next Tue (2026003200). will post short daily updates in this thread. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
